record.title: Rooftop Solar PV Mounting Systems - Mechanical and Installation Requirements
record.description:
Defines mechanical strength, corrosion protection, attachment, load-path, and installation documentation requirements for rooftop mounting systems supporting solar photovoltaic modules.

Applies to fixed rooftop mounting systems for small and medium distributed solar PV installations; excludes ground-mounted utility-scale systems and tracking structures.

Key requirements: Mounting members shall withstand declared design loads for the installation zone.; Fasteners and attachment details shall maintain the specified load path.; Corrosion protection shall match the declared environmental exposure.

Testing: Mechanical load verification for representative assemblies.; Fastener and connection strength checks.
record.certification_applicability: Certification may be required when the mounting product is covered by a procurement or project conformity specification; this standard alone does not universally mandate certification.
